context.transcript:
Thanks for joining our city tour.
My name is Hector Flore and I take great pride in all that Clearview has to offer.
Over the coming hour, we'll be discussing the city's founding and historical development.
Please feel free to ask me questions as we go.
By the way, Oyour tickets will get you a discount to be used at any of the eateries at Seafront Park.
That's where we'll be ending our tour.
Don't worry, you'll have plenty of time to enjoy your meal before you're due to get back on your cruise ship at 8 p.m.
context.transcript_translation:
感谢参加我们的城市观光游。
我叫 Hector Flore，我为 Clearview 所提供的所有内容感到非常自豪。
在接下来的一个小时里，我们将讨论这座城市的创立和历史发展。
请随时提问。
顺便说一句，您的票可以在海滨公园的任何餐馆享受折扣优惠。
我们将在那里结束我们的游览。
别担心，您有充足的时间在返回邮轮（时间是晚上 8 点）之前享用您的餐点。
